title: 学习型线控训练治理：压力下的有界自主训练实现稳定性与效率
summary: 提出LBW-Guard，一种位于AdamW之上的有界自主训练控制治理层，通过观察训练遥测并应用有界控制来提升LLM训练的稳定性与效率。在Qwen2.5-7B上，困惑度从13.21降至10.74（提升18.7%），训练时间从392.54秒降至357.02秒（加速1.10倍）。在高学习率压力下，AdamW退化严重，而LBW-Guard仍保持可训练状态。
summary_en: Introduces LBW-Guard, a bounded autonomous training control governance layer above AdamW that observes training telemetry and applies bounded control to improve LLM training stability and efficiency. On Qwen2.5-7B, perplexity drops from 13.21 to 10.74 (18.7% improvement) and training time reduces from 392.54s to 357.02s (1.10x speedup). Under high learning rate stress, AdamW degrades severely while LBW-Guard remains trainable.
